reason: In src/sentry/integrations/source_code_management/commit_context.py, MERGED_PR_SINGLE_ISSUE_TEMPLATE is now "* ‼️ [**{title}**]({url}){environment}\n". get_merged_pr_single_issue_template only shortens the title with _truncate_title and fills it in with .format, without escaping ']' or other markdown characters. Before the patch the title was only bold text ("**{title}**") and sat outside any link, so a ']' in it could not break a link.
